chunks: And it was narrated from Ḥumrān ibn Aʿyan, from one of the two of them, peace be upon them, who said:
"My father, peace be upon him, when he prayed sitting, he would sit cross-legged; and when he bowed, he would fold his legs."
ai.seo_question: How did the Imam عليه السلام perform salat while sitting and going into ruku'?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the manner in which an Imam عليه السلام performed salat while seated. It indicates a practical ruling and precedent for the posture of one who prays sitting, including sitting cross-legged and then folding the legs in ruku'.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1049 - It was narrated from Humran ibn A'yan, from one of the Imams (as), who said:
"My father (as) when he prayed while sitting, he would sit cross-legged, and when he went into ruku' (bowing), he would fold his legs."
